title: Evidence of behavior consistent with self-interest and altruism in an artificially intelligent agent
findings: This paper contains no findings related to religion, as it does not investigate any aspect of religion or faith.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure anything in terms of faith or religion. It measured altruistic and self-interested behavior in AI agents using economic games (specifically, a non-social decision task and a dictator game). One condition involved sharing resources with an 'anonymous charity,' but this was framed as a test of general altruism, not religious sentiment.
